name: The Tome of Divinity

meta.previous: Tome of Divinity (Brother Wilhelm) / Tome of Divinity (5)

summary: In Stormwind, The Tome of Divinity guides young paladins through a solemn rite. Under Duthorian Rall's care in the Cathedral of Light, you face teachings on virtue, devotion, and the duties that come with the Holy Light.

sections.title: A Paladin's Calling
sections.body: Duthorian Rall guides those who answer the paladin's calling in the Cathedral of Light. Early training teaches martial discipline and the order's rites, but advancement asks for a deeper commitment to the spirit. The trials ask you to look beyond battle and weigh the moral duties of a paladin. Stormwind faces dangers within its borders and beyond, and its people need defenders who understand that duty.

sections.title: The Path of Virtue
sections.body: Receiving the Book of Divinity binds you to service and self-sacrifice. Duthorian asks you to study the holy text and learn what the Light demands of its defenders. Its lessons prepare paladins to oppose the Scourge's creeping horrors and protect common folk. Righteous power must answer to virtue and compassion.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Tome of Divinity?
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity tests a developing paladin's grasp of sacred principles. Before greater divine abilities are entrusted to an initiate, their strength must be grounded in devotion and virtue, not martial force alone.
Duthorian Rall is a senior paladin trainer in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He guides new paladins, gives them the Book of Divinity, and directs their trials across the kingdom.

faq.q: Where does this trial take place?
faq.answer: The trial begins in Stormwind City's Cathedral Square, inside the Cathedral of Light. After preliminary duties in outer townships such as Goldshire, initiates report to Duthorian Rall.

faq.q: Why is the Scourge mentioned in Stormwind's teachings?
faq.answer: The Scourge devastated Lordaeron to the north, but its undead remain a threat to all living mortals. Stormwind's paladins learn to recognize and fight the Scourge's unholy corruption wherever it appears across Azeroth.

faq.q: What comes after reading the Book of Divinity?
faq.answer: Reading the Book of Divinity is only the first step. Duthorian Rall tests whether you have taken its lessons to heart by sending you to aid those in dire need, where deeds must prove your compassion and resilience.

faq.q: Who normally directs candidates to Duthorian Rall?
faq.answer: Local instructors and clergy in Elwynn's outlying settlements can direct candidates to Duthorian Rall. Brother Wilhelm in Goldshire is one such guide, sending initiates to the capital when they are ready for formal trials.

angles.text: As a paladin, this rite marks your passage from an apprentice of arms to a servant of the Holy Light. It sets out the sacrifice and mercy at the heart of the order.
As a human of Stormwind, you honor the fallen knights of Lordaeron and carry on the Silver Hand's proud tradition in the southern kingdom.
As an Alliance member, your training strengthens Stormwind's heart and prepares its paladins to shield the Alliance from rising darkness.
